results.detail: FT test is cw.gen_identitynumber = ft.Gen_identitynumber (proven, aliased). The fund test is quoted verbatim and the binding is labelled השערה. The text states the INNER JOIN SystemUser + DomainName != ? restriction (team owners and NULL domain excluded). Trans/MF are aligned where f.OwnerId != x.OwnerId. The scopeNote matches the DTSX: [CRM] = Psql/ALTSHULER_MSCRM; config DTSX:17; 8 OLE DB Command UPDATEs on [CRM]; SDK only in the 3 ETL writers (DTSX:278 Create, 848 Update, 5325/5334 Update+annotation Create); End ETL Lookup on [CRM] at DTSX:2235. The sentence 'כל העדכונים הם SQL ישיר' is read in business scope, because the same claim's scopeNote lists the SDK framework writers.

The chain is re-derived from the 10 precedence constraints DTSX:5115-5124: all LogicalAnd=True, no Value attribute (so Success), no expressions, no disabled executables. Get Variables has no incoming constraint. The OnError handler is at DTSX:5127/5134. Step titles use the variable/table labels. Step 3 keeps the fund binding as השערה.

Both Regular sources use join SystemUser + DomainName != ? (Parameter0 <- RegularFundsDomainName {781FC0E7}) and the not exists subqueries as quoted. An earlier manual assignment to another user with a non-NULL domain is overwritten on the next run. Team owners fail the INNER JOIN, and a NULL DomainName fails !=.

The flow order matches the constraints. The 0008 fact was re-traced: the only paths into insert ftCurrentYearBase 1-5 come from Split Rows For MultiThread, which is fed (via Union All 3 / Union All Records / ... / Union All) only by Split by trans group type output 'תנועות והחזר דמי ניהול' (FriendlyExpression gen_TranstypeId != "58" && Transfer_Type_2 == "2", 0008 DTSX:69986). No other supplied package inserts into Gen_ftCurrentYear(Base). The Trans/MF sources have no SystemUser join, so 'בלי קשר לסוג הבעלים' is correct. The fund binding is labelled השערה.

No flat-file connection exists (only CRM and SRS.SSIS_Logs). The owner restriction (non-NULL domain different from target), the fund binding as השערה, the FT test by ft.Gen_identitynumber and the Trans/MF alignment all match the SQL.

Units 1-11 and 13 verified. Unit 1: gen_etlvariable where gen_scope='global' or = System::PackageName (DTSX:2317-2326); PostExecute assigns each ReadWrite variable or throws (DTSX:2435-2441, ReadWriteVariables DTSX:3165). Units 3-7 match the 8 UPDATE flows and their order. Unit 12 is wrong as a general statement. The 'לא' branch of 'האם כל שלב הסתיים בהצלחה?' says the error handler marks the process as failed. The handler (DTSX:5319-5334) does Update gen_etlprocess with entity.Id = (Guid)Dts.Variables["ETLProcessRecordGuid"].Value and statuscode 277880001, then creates an annotation. ETLProcessRecordGuid is set only by Create ETL Process record (DTSX:278, step 2); its design-time value is an empty Object (DTSX:33-41). So if step 1 (Get Variables, which unit 1 says fails when a key is missing) or step 2 fails, no gen_etlprocess record exists and nothing is marked; the cast/Update would fail. Fix: limit the marking to failures after Create ETL Process record, or say that a failure before it leaves nothing to mark. Secondary note: 'כשגוי' interprets statuscode 277880001 from the handler being OnError; the option-set label is not in the files.
wrongUnits: [12] (step) branch 'לא': 'ומטפל השגיאות מסמן את התהליך כשגוי' - not true for failures in Get Variables / Create ETL Process record (no ETLProcessRecordGuid yet)
